parsed.rationale: Both `app:WatchXYC` (WXYC/WatchXYC/PlayerPage.swift:210) and `app:iOS` (WXYC/iOS/NowPlayingWidget/Extensions.swift:47) define an identical computed property `SwiftUI.Image.background`, flagged as an exact function duplicate with no differing slots. Neither record carries any test, codegen, mock, or sample-app flag, so the duplication is unintentional. The property should be extracted into a shared Swift package (e.g., a `SharedUI` or `CommonExtensions` module that both targets already depend on, or a new one created for this purpose) as an `extension Image` computed property, and the two local definitions removed. If no shared module currently exists, the iOS `Extensions.swift` file is the more natural home given it already aggregates extensions, and the WatchXYC copy should be deleted in favour of a cross-target dependency.
